**Davi Moreira** is a Clinical Assistant Professor in the Quantitative Methods
Department and Director of the Daniels Undergraduate Business Honors Program at
Purdue University. His academic work addresses Political Communication, Data
Science, Text as Data, Artificial Intelligence, and Comparative Politics. He
has also worked as a Monitoring & Evaluation Specialist consultant for the
World Bank in Brazil, Mozambique, Angola, and the Democratic Republic of the
Congo.

- Website: [davi-moreira.github.io](https://davi-moreira.github.io/){target="_blank"}
- Email: [dcordeir@purdue.edu](mailto:dcordeir@purdue.edu)
:::
:::

He wrote this book for the students he teaches: undergraduates in economics,
political science, business, and biology who want to produce research they can
defend, in a world where AI can produce almost everything else. The book's one
rule is also his own working rule: AI is your arm and your research assistant,
not your brain.

## Off the clock

Two things you will eventually hear about if you take his classes.

**Palmeiras.** The greatest Brazilian football club, and the author's most
rigorous lifelong training in uncertainty.
